description: A photograph shows a field of young, green maize (corn) plants being irrigated. In the foreground, an open-air irrigation channel, resembling a traditional acequia, transports water. The channel begins with a circular concrete or stone basin filled with water, from which a long, elevated, dark-coloured trough extends into the field. The maize crop covers most of the visible land, appearing healthy and uniformly green. In the mid-ground and background, various trees and shrubs are visible, with what appear to be distant rural structures or houses under a bright sky. The scene depicts a typical setup for traditional irrigated arable land.
